facts.summary: Phone target scale is clamp((1-d)+1,1,1.6), with d based on abs adjusted player-to-desired-camera delta normalized by90/60. HD processCamera body has no matching distance-driven scale write; global HD zoom absence is not established.
facts.limit: The algebraic shorthand 2-d does not authorize changing the original FP operation order. Device-vs-release cause is unknown. This is not a decision to copy a phone-specific zoom implementation.

facts.summary: Phone manager first subtracts half-screen. World input uses reciprocal manager scale then camera center/offsets. World y<-114 HUD boundary, pause and live-player gates are distinct.

Phone reads MachList Rad, converts int to float, multiplies0.5, truncates int into info+0x20. Instance+0x3c points to that definition. Selection compares distance squared to (stored radius*1.5)^2. HD Rad setter stores the integer directly and selection uses radius squared.
facts.limit: Actual screen-pixel boundary ratio was not executed or measured; phone map coordinates also halve and camera scale varies.

facts.summary: HD QobBase tick computes isInCam and stores isInScreen. HD ground movement checks it after aircraft exception. The analogous phone tree/visual/movement entry bodies have no corresponding cache or common gate in the inspected bodies.

findings.phone: EAGL initWithCoder sets interface orientation 3, configures orthographic projection from screen bounds; createSurface stores half view dimensions at manager+0x60/+0x64. Touch methods Y-flip locationInView and use phases begin=1/move=2/end=3. Manager 0x4e0e4 subtracts half-screen before dispatch. Thus original phone UI handler coordinates are center-relative. The cached host derives dimensions from bounds; this is not evidence of a literal 480x320 universal constant.
findings.hd: HD touch methods Y-flip but use phases 0/1/2. GuiHelp consumes positive-screen X thresholds 204 and 564, unlike phone -112/+112. Do not directly reuse numeric phase values or local coordinates across binaries.
findings.design_consequence: Keep UIKit/Metal host in physical-point/pixel/safe-area boundary only. Common viewport must provide one invertible render/input mapping for HD layout nodes. Original phone runtime 480x320 measurement is a separate sampled observation; code paths here do not establish phone zoom for every world/state.

findings.phone: 0x520c0 tries basename@2x.extension only for deviceType3, falls back to original key/file and sets forRetina accordingly. Constructor 0x51d9c initially sets type2. Separately 0x524a8 sets forRetina(true) whenever type!=1, even after fallback, so forRetina does not imply an @2x physical filename. HUD WeaponCap uses this explicit path. TileSplit0x4b850 halves logical tileWidth/Height when forRetina. Draw0x4b4b8 multiplies supplied visual scales by0.5 when forRetina.
findings.hd: HD getTile/getTileForRetina has the same conditional @2x lookup vs explicit flag distinction. HD constructor detects iPad type1 and retina phone type3. HD TileSplit0x43ea8 computes logical tileWidth/Height without the phone conditional half; HD draw0x444ac does halve supplied scales when forRetina.
findings.design_consequence: Track physical file size, atlas split, logical tile size, sprite origin and draw scale separately. Their half factors serve different consumers; do not double-apply a retina factor or treat a phone logical getter as an HD pixel dimension. Preserve HD asset metadata and choose layout/world density in common config.
